token.antigo_expira: the previous token remains valid until {quando}
token.escopos_ajuda: a scope without :<uuid> covers all layers; tenant administration only for the administrator profile
token.ip_ajuda: one per line, such as 10.0.0.0/8 or 203.0.113.7; empty = any IP
token.referer_ajuda: one per line, such as https://gis.example.gov or https://*.example.gov; empty = any origin
token.renovar_confirma: renew {nome}? A new token is created with the same scopes; the old one remains valid for 24 more hours.
token.revogar_confirma: revoke {nome}? Whoever uses it gets 401 on the next call.
token.uma_vez: the token is shown only once; copy it now.
tokens.rodape: the token is shown only once, at creation and renewal; revocation takes effect immediately
tokens.servicos_ajuda: QGIS, ArcGIS Pro/AGOL and OGC catalogues use these URLs with a service token; the required scope is shown next to each
tracadoresultado.acoes: What to do with the result
tracadoresultado.ajuda: Trace over a utility network and turn the result into a selection, layer or file. The aggregations alongside add up by asset type and by voltage level.
upload.arquivo_pronto: the file is in storage and ready to become an import in /conteudo
upload.dropzone: drag the file here or click to choose
upload.dropzone_ajuda: several files at once; up to {tamanho} each, sent in {parte} parts with resume
upload.erro_preparar: could not prepare the upload (service token)
upload.erro_rede_parte: the network dropped while sending part {n}
upload.est_concluindo: finishing (verifying the content on the server)…
upload.formato_sem_publicacao: file uploaded; this format does not have automatic publishing yet (it stays saved as a file in /conteudo).
upload.formatos_resumo: image formats accepted on import ({n} accepted, {m} refused)
upload.parcial: {ok} uploaded, {falhas} failed; use 'try again' on the file's row
upload.pergunta_desconhecida: the proposal also asks for: {perguntas} — this screen does not answer for these yet; publish via the API or ask for help.
